resources.string: Help improve Hideout by sharing usage data.

Hideout sends daily app activity and feature results to PostHog in the EU. Events include timing ranges, failure categories, import source manager, app version, and operating system. A random installation ID links repeat use. Turn sharing off in Settings → About.

We measure installs, imports, 3D preview loads, and custom game hosting and joining. For public custom games, we also record the catalog mode name and ID, your host or guest role, and connected time in whole minutes. We do not send Steam accounts, skin or audio mod names or IDs, searches, files, invite codes, or recordings. Local mode folders are excluded. Turning this off stops new collection and clears unsent events. It does not delete events already received.
